met_analysis:
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Deesa, centre of Low-Pressure area over southeast Rajasthan & adjoining Madhya Pradesh, Guna, Khajuraho, Dehri, Shantiniketan, & thence eastwards towards Mizoram and extends upto 3.1 km above mean sea level.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over Northwest Bay of Bengal & neighbourhood between 5.8 & 9.6 km above mean sea level. The east-west shear zone roughly along 23°N Lat. between 4.5 & 7.6 km above mean sea level tilting southwards with height persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over central Assam & neighbourhood now lies over northeast Assam & neighbourhood and extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over Jammu & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level with a trough aloft in middle & upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 7.6 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 68°E to the north of Lat. 29°N persists.
